override._why: In the garage (from about 60 s), A on Exit Garage opens 'Exit the garage?', which defaults to NO. Up then A, just after the default A that opens it (default A presses fall at 63, 68, 73... s), picks YES and starts the first race. Up in the button cycle instead wanders into the Options menus.
